description: Before paying an x402 endpoint: fetch it, validate its HTTP 402 payment requirements (scheme, network, payTo, amount, asset) and screen payTo against the OFAC SDN crypto-address list. Returns verdict ok|warn|block|not_402. Free to try: 20 MCP calls/day per client, no API key or wallet needed (beyond that: prepaid credits via header X-API-Key, see server instructions).

method.description: HTTP method the endpoint expects; default GET

url.description: x402 endpoint you plan to pay

name: x402_precheck
title: Pre-check an x402 payment
